cases.summary: Promo code: a valid code lowers the basket total by its percentage
cases.description: Covers AC-101-1. Oracle: the percentage printed on the promo code record, applied to the basket subtotal before delivery (product answer Q1).

steps.step: Add products worth 40.00 to the basket

steps.result: Discount line shows -4.00 and the subtotal shows 36.00

cases.summary: Promo code: an expired code is rejected with a message
cases.description: Covers AC-101-2. Oracle: the expiry date on the promo code record.

steps.step: Add any product to the basket

steps.result: Message says the code has expired; the total does not change

cases.summary: Promo code: a second code is not stacked on the first
cases.description: Covers AC-101-3. Oracle: product answer Q3 (one code per order; the second is refused).

steps.step: Apply SAVE10 to a basket worth 40.00
Enter a second valid code and press Apply
steps.result: Message says only one code can be used; the subtotal stays 36.00

cases.summary: Promo code: the code is not case sensitive
cases.description: Covers AC-101-4. Oracle: product answer Q4 (codes are not case sensitive).

steps.step: Add products worth 40.00 to the basket
Enter save10 in lower case and press Apply
steps.result: The code is accepted and the subtotal shows 36.00
